svg.title: Prompting Techniques: Pick by the Gap
svg.desc: Five prompting techniques and the gap each fixes: zero-shot for simple clear tasks, few-shot for a format or style, chain-of-thought for multi-step reasoning, role prompting for voice and expertise, and a system prompt for rules on every turn.
svg.text: Prompting Techniques: Pick by the Gap
Each technique fixes one kind of problem.
Must match a format or style
